name: Mahou Bishoujo Magical ☆ Moerin ♪ S
original_name: 魔法美少女まじかる☆萌えりん♪S
source:
Masaharu spends noisy days together with his imouto who’s a little lacking in morals. On his way home from school one day, he came upon a mahou shoujo surrounded by people in black tights who could easily be mistaken for perverts. He recognized her as his osananajimi who had left a year ago. The next day, the bad guys turned to attack him and other mahou shoujos showed up to fight them. Will they be able to protect him?

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/02/05/february-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
纪城正治与一个伦理观念稍显淡薄的妹妹同住，每天都过得吵吵闹闹。某天放学回家途中，他偶然看到一名魔法少女，正被一群身穿黑色紧身衣、怎么看都像变态的人包围。他认出那名魔法少女，正是1年前离开的青梅竹马。

第二天，那群坏人改为向正治发动袭击，其他魔法少女也陆续现身，与他们交战。她们能够保护正治吗？

[引自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/02/05/february-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
